stripe_price_id.description: Stripe price ID after synchronization. Null for local prices that have not synced yet.

previous_price_id.description: Optional lineage pointer when an archived Stripe Price is replaced.

unit_amount.description: Sale amount charged to the customer in the smallest currency unit.

tenant_keyed_amount.description: Amount entered by the tenant before fee-handling adjustments. For net_guaranteed prices, unit_amount is grossed up from this value.

compare_at_unit_amount.description: Higher reference amount shown as a struck-through regular price.

quantity.description: Quantity represented by this Stripe Price, such as units in a bundle or sessions in a package.

pricing_model.description: How the amount is decided. customer_chooses is a TIP JAR: the buyer picks, so unit_amount is not the answer for it -- presets and/or allow_custom are.

min_amount.description: Smallest amount the buyer may pay, in the smallest currency unit. customer_chooses only. SET BY THE PLATFORM (src/stripe_link/tip_rules.json) and overwritten on validation -- a tenant does not choose the range. Enforced server-side at checkout, never only in the UI.

suggested_amount.description: DEPRECATED 2026-09-13 in favour of presets[]. Kept so existing documents still validate; migrate it in as the single preset and stop writing it.

fee_handling.description: Merchant's share of the fees: standard = merchant absorbs all, split = shared 50/50 (buyer price grossed up by half the fees), net_guaranteed = buyer covers all (merchant nets tenant_keyed_amount).

presets.description: Amounts offered as buttons, in the smallest currency unit. What the TENANT KEEPS -- their keyed amount, exactly as tenant_keyed_amount is for a fixed price. What the buyer pays for each sits in preset_charges, and the fee_handling mode decides the distance between them. At most five (four when allow_custom is set, since 'enter your own' takes one of the five places in the row). customer_chooses only.

max_amount.description: Largest amount the buyer may pay. SET BY THE PLATFORM (src/stripe_link/tip_rules.json) and overwritten on validation: a ceiling keeps a mistyped amount from becoming a dispute. customer_chooses only.

allow_custom.description: Whether the buyer may type their own amount alongside the presets. customer_chooses only.

allow_recurring.description: Whether the buyer may make the tip recurring. customer_chooses only.

allow_one_time.description: Whether a single, non-repeating tip is offered. Absent means YES. Setting it false alongside allow_recurring makes the jar recurring-only -- a membership, where a one-off payment would buy nothing. Both false is refused: the jar would accept nothing. customer_chooses only.

recurring_interval.description: Interval offered when allow_recurring is true. Stripe's four.

preset_charges.description: What the BUYER is charged for each entry in presets[], same order, smallest first. Computed at authoring time by the platform's price calculation, because the renderer has no billing config to gross up with. Absent on documents written before presets carried a keyed/charged split -- there, presets[] were themselves the charged amounts.
